E2E-001.rationale: A real Playwright test navigates to the supplied real HTTP endpoint.

E2E-002.rationale: The project Playwright configuration selects its complete test set.

E2E-003.rationale: Counts come from structured Playwright test records.

E2E-004.rationale: A real failed assertion returns a failed provider result after retries.

E2E-005.rationale: The provider rejects an empty structured test set.

E2E-006.rationale: The trusted capability owns one total deadline and process-tree cancellation.

E2E-007.rationale: Structured failures retain test identity and the final error message.

E2E-008.rationale: Realpath checks bind project, config, and attachment paths to the attempt repository.

E2E-009.rationale: The editable suite template resolves through the provider registry.

E2E-010.rationale: Playwright is a registered provider and Buster core only routes its capability.

E2E-011.rationale: The fixture config owns testDir and browser project selection.

E2E-012.rationale: The real fixture config owns retries and can own authentication setup.

E2E-013.rationale: The real fixture config creates failure screenshots and traces.

E2E-014.rationale: Only endpoint environment and execution controls are added by the overlay.

E2E-015.rationale: The capability forces Playwright JSON reporting and the provider parses no console counts.

E2E-016.rationale: The failed real test stores its JSON report, screenshot, and trace.

E2E-017.rationale: Provider details record the real-chromium project identity.

E2E-018.rationale: The provider request is reduced by operator maximumWorkers and plan process limits.

E2E-019.rationale: Capability and provider enforce output, report, artifact-file, artifact-byte, and deadline limits.

E2E-020.rationale: Playwright completes the selected project run and returns one aggregate report.

E2E-021.rationale: Skipped and unexecuted counts remain explicit and do not create a numeric allowance.

E2E-022.rationale: Blocking versus advisory authority remains a Nova plan-node policy.

E2E-023.rationale: The remote proof authorizes an exact origin and production declares typed deployment input.

E2E-024.rationale: The vertical proof signs source and authenticates Nova-to-Buster dispatch.

E2E-025.rationale: The isolated provider result and test report are imported into Nova.

E2E-026.rationale: Playwright stdout and stderr are sent to canonical bounded logs.

E2E-027.rationale: Project and config paths are explicit repository-relative fields.

E2E-DEFECT-028.rationale: No replacement code parses passed or failed text from console output.

E2E-DEFECT-029.rationale: The replacement schema has no threshold or max-failure field.

E2E-DEFECT-030.rationale: Legacy protocol and suite runner no longer accept e2e.
